purpose: Candidate Learn and Field Guide content, as data. This is product content data, not planning material: it lives beside catalog.json and source-registry.json, is versioned with the content it governs, and is uploaded to the delivery platform config share so the content builder can read it. A list the builder cannot see cannot drive a build.
usageRules: Discovery inputs only. Never copy course outlines, lesson sequences, exercises, assessment items, artwork, branding, or proprietary teaching structure from any watched service.
Every delivered item needs original instruction, primary-source evidence, accessibility assets, and a named freshness owner.
A watch-list entry is evidence of market demand and topic vocabulary. It is never a content source.

coverageBaseline.method: Word-boundary regex over all committed module, resource and resource-pack JSON. Counts are occurrences, not modules.
